decisions.reason: 입을 열었다 is the start-speaking beat; SOL drops the mouth calque without losing 침착하게.
노부 may be I here; SOL’s this old man’s sight is a stiff self-reference calque of 눈앞에서 꺼져.
Same 몸을 돌리다 / 입을 열었다 beat; spoke up is natural English where opened my mouth is body-part translationese.
광물 is mineral, not ore; BASE’s that made it adds unstated causality, SOL’s thing is too vague.
decisions.replacement: Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron: a mysterious mineral imbued with a supernatural power—the hardest and sharpest material in the world, able to withstand even Sword Energy.
